audit_scope: exam setup, selection, navigation, timers, submission, scoring, result review
Mistake Notebook, recovery practice, study links, Notes, Flashcards
mobile HTML/CSS accessibility and navigation contracts
question selection eligibility, quarantine, attempt/session security

findings.evidence: Cold board-filtered flashcard requests reloaded the full question bank during production-derived eligibility validation although the controller already held that canonical snapshot.
findings.repair: Pass the request's full canonical snapshot through the existing eligibility index and resolver; validate through a compact question-to-concept map.
findings.result: cold question reads reduced from 3 to 2; controlled-process peak memory decreased from 291.5 MiB to 207.5 MiB

findings.evidence: Exam simulation, timer expiry, answer navigation, partial scoring, retry, result review and repeated/concurrent exact-once submission regressions passed.
findings.repair: No exam-code change was justified by the audit.

findings.priority: no static/HTTP contract defect found; browser acceptance unavailable
findings.evidence: 18 accessibility/mobile and 8 navigation assertions passed; responsive CSS breakpoints cover 320, 360, 390 and 430 CSS-pixel widths.
findings.limitation: No real Chromium/Playwright renderer was available, so visual overflow was not claimed as browser-verified.

nonblocking_action_queue.action: Retain conservative review queue and revisit with new evidence.
Keep future expansion post-release and evidence-backed.
